title: Build a hosted evidence URL
responsibility: Validates evidence-request fields and builds their ordered hosted API address.

inputs.name: hostedEvidencePath.input
inputs.description: The project and evidence scope; artifact operations also need the capture-binding fields at runtime. Project IDs are 1–128 characters, beginning with a letter or digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.

inputs.name: hostedEvidencePath.operation
inputs.description: Choose evidence for metadata or artifact for capture bytes.

outputs.name: hostedEvidencePath
outputs.description: A relative API URL for the encoded project and operation, with validated fields in a fixed query order. Null values are omitted and extra input fields are discarded. No network call is made.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for an invalid project identity or missing or invalid evidence/artifact fields.
